_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).
period: Unifications of Italy and Germany, 1848 to 1871

events.label: Revolutions of 1848 in the German states
events.desc: Uprisings in Berlin, Vienna and other capitals force rulers to promise constitutions.

events.label: Frankfurt Parliament opens
events.desc: The first freely elected parliament for all of Germany meets in the Paulskirche.

events.label: Battle of Novara
events.desc: Austria defeats Piedmont; Charles Albert abdicates in favour of Victor Emmanuel II.

events.label: Battle of Solferino
events.desc: French and Piedmontese armies defeat Austria; Piedmont gains Lombardy.

events.label: Expedition of the Thousand lands in Sicily
events.desc: Garibaldi's volunteers land at Marsala and go on to take Sicily and Naples.

events.label: Kingdom of Italy proclaimed
events.desc: Victor Emmanuel II becomes King of Italy; Turin is the first capital.

events.label: Bismarck becomes Minister President of Prussia
events.desc: William I appoints Bismarck during a conflict with parliament over the army.

events.label: Second Schleswig War
events.desc: Prussia and Austria defeat Denmark, which gives up Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg.

events.label: Battle of Königgrätz
events.desc: Prussia defeats Austria in the decisive battle of the Seven Weeks' War.

events.label: Peace of Prague
events.desc: Austria leaves German affairs; Italy receives Venetia.

events.label: North German Confederation formed
events.desc: Prussia leads a federal state of the German states north of the Main.

events.label: Battle of Sedan
events.desc: Napoleon III and his army are captured; the Second Empire falls.

events.label: Capture of Rome
events.desc: Italian troops enter Rome, which becomes the capital of Italy.

events.label: German Empire proclaimed
events.desc: William I of Prussia is proclaimed German Emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles.

events.label: Treaty of Frankfurt
events.desc: France cedes Alsace and part of Lorraine and pays an indemnity.
